glaideResponses.fee: I can help with fee queries. Most installment mismatches clear within 24 hours of payment. Could you tell me the date and amount you paid?
glaideResponses.olympus: Olympus glitches are usually fixed by a hard refresh or clearing the cache. What screen were you on when it broke?
glaideResponses.career: Career Services covers resume reviews, mock interviews, and referrals. Which of these do you need help with?
glaideResponses.projects: Happy to help with your project. Is this about the brief, a submission error, or feedback you received?
glaideResponses.material: I can point you to the right module content. Which topic is giving you trouble?
glaideResponses.sessions: For live sessions I can share recordings or attendance fixes. Which session is this about?
glaideResponses.quizzes: Let's sort this out. Could you share a bit more about what's happening so I can point you the right way?
glaideResponses.other: Tell me a bit more about the issue and I will do my best to help.
glaideResponses.feedback: Thanks for sharing feedback. I am listening, go ahead.
glaideResponses.fallback: I want to make sure I get this right. Could you add a little more detail?

Sample solutions release 7 days after the submission deadline for "{project}". You will get a notification when it is available.
Let's debug "{project}" together. Share the exact error message or the line it fails on, and tell me what you have already tried.
Happy to explain. Tell me which part of "{project}" is unclear and I will walk you through it step by step.
That one is best handled by your program team. I can raise a ticket with "{project}" and what you described so they can help.
